articles.title: Wynn Donates MOP5 Million to Support Relief and Recovery Efforts in Gyirong, Xizang
articles.summary: Macao, September 4, 2026 – A severe mudslide recently struck Gyirong County, Xigaze City, Xizang Autonomous Region, resulting in significant casualties and property losses. The disaster has drawn widespread concern from all sectors of society. articles.title: Wynn Palace Becomes the First in Macao to Debut on The World's 50 Best Hotels 2026 Extended 51-100 List
articles.summary: Macao, September 2, 2026 – Wynn Palace has been named No.96 on The World's 50 Best Hotels 2026 extended 51–100 list, becoming the first hotel in Macao to be recognized in the prestigious global award.
